issues.main_description_html:
Problem

Currently, the only way to update the RAG knowledge base is to manually place .md files in the actions/ directory and call POST /ingest/actions to reload the entire index. There is no way to upload a single action document through the API without knowing the filesystem layout.

Proposed Solution

Add a new POST /upload/action endpoint that:

  • Accepts a single .md file via multipart/form-data (field name: action)
  • Authenticates with the same X-Admin-Key header as /ingest/actions
  • Sanitizes the filename and persists it to actions/ (overwrites existing files with the same slug)
  • Validates the upload: only .md files, must produce at least one KnowledgeDocument after parsing
  • Calls reload_catalog() to hot-reload the RAG index without restarting the server
  • Returns the saved slug, document count, and endpoint count

Design

  • Route: POST /upload/action (registered on the admin router)
  • Auth: X-Admin-Key header, same as existing admin endpoints
  • Request: multipart/form-data with a single file field action
  • Response: 200 with {slug, saved_to, documents_loaded, endpoints_loaded}
  • Errors: 401 (invalid/missing key), 422 (non-md, empty, unparseable), 500 (disk/reload failure)

Acceptance Criteria

  • Upload a valid .md → 200, file persisted in actions/, RAG index reloaded
  • File is retrievable via /chat immediately after upload
  • Auth required — anonymous requests return 401
  • Non-.md files rejected with 422
  • Empty/unparseable files rejected with 422
  • Duplicate slugs overwrite existing files
  • Full test suite passes (pytest tests/)
  • Add python-multipart dependency (required by FastAPI for file uploads)

Implementation Plan

See: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-31-action-upload.md

issues.display_title: Issue #3: Segregate Base Knowledge and Uploaded Actions for RAG
issues.main_description_html:
Problem

Currently, the system mixes standard GoThru base knowledge with user-uploaded custom actions inside the same actions/ directory. Git tracking uploaded files becomes complicated, and base system knowledge cannot be safely segregated.

Proposed Solution

Separate RAG knowledge into two distinct directories:

  • A new base-knowledge/ directory for the system's baseline RAG .md documents.
  • Keep the existing actions/ directory solely as a destination for the POST /upload/action endpoint.
    Both directories will be aggregated by the RAG loader.

Design

  • Configuration: Add base_knowledge_dir to app/core/config.py in addition to actions_dir.
  • Loader: Modify load_action_documents in app/ingestion/action_loader.py to accept multiple paths and aggregate the KnowledgeDocument results.
  • RAG Engine Initialization: Provide both directories to the loader during startup (routes_chat.py) and ingestion endpoints (routes_admin.py).
  • File System: Move existing .md files to base-knowledge/. Ignore the actions/ folder via .gitignore to prevent uploaded files from entering version control.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Base RAG knowledge moved completely to base-knowledge/.
  • actions/ folder ignored by Git.
  • RAG system startup and /ingest/actions loads files from both directories.
  • /upload/action endpoint persists files only into actions/ and reloads correctly.
  • Full test suite passes (pytest tests/).

Implementation Plan

Implementation already completed via RAG Copilot CLI based on standard plan template.

issues.display_title: Issue #5: Delete Endpoint for Uploaded Actions
issues.main_description_html:
Problem

The system can upload custom .md action documents via POST /upload/action, but there is no mechanism to remove these files once they are no longer needed or if they were uploaded incorrectly.

Proposed Solution

Add a new DELETE /upload/action/{slug} endpoint that allows an authenticated admin to remove an uploaded .md action document from the system and automatically refresh the RAG knowledge index.

Design

  • Route: DELETE /upload/action/{slug} (registered on the admin router)
  • Auth: X-Admin-Key header, same as existing admin endpoints
  • Behavior: Unlinks the specific .md file from actions/ based on the slug format.
  • Refresh: Automatically triggers load_action_documents and routes_chat.reload_catalog to update RAG without restart.
  • Response: 200 with {slug, status: "deleted"}
  • Errors: 401 (invalid/missing key), 404 (action file not found), 500 (disk remove or reload failure)

Acceptance Criteria

  • DELETE request with authentic key removes the corresponding .md file from actions/
  • RAG index is updated immediately after the successful file deletion
  • Auth required — anonymous requests return 401
  • Attempting to delete an unknown slug returns 404
  • Automated tests created inside test_upload_action.py to cover deletion logic
  • All tests pass

Implementation Plan

Implementation completed via Kimi Code AI Agent.
